title: ShipmentReconciliationRequested v1 payload
description: A courier call came back UNCERTAIN and the in-route status query did not settle it. The consumer asks the partner again, later; it never repeats the original call. Identifiers only: no address, contact name, phone number, or provider body, because ADR 0029 keeps personal data off every topic and a courier command is exactly where it would otherwise leak.

operationCommandId.description: The delivery command whose outcome is unknown. Also the provider idempotency key, so a reconciliation cannot be mistaken for a fresh operation.

bindingId.description: The ADR 0026 binding to re-resolve. Never trusted as authority: the consumer resolves the candidate bindings for the envelope's tenant and refuses a binding that is not among them.

capability.description: The operation whose outcome is unknown, for the runbook and the metric. The reconciliation itself is always a status query.

externalReference.description: The partner's own identifier for the shipment. Required: with nothing to query by there is no safe automated move, so the route escalates to a person instead of issuing this command.

uncertainErrorCode.description: The classification that made this uncertain, such as READ_TIMEOUT. A code, never a provider message.
